name: tool-lights
description: A one-line strip of lights above the prompt, one per plugin tool or skill, that expands into a pane. A light goes amber while a call runs, green when it returns, red when it fails. Pin the ones you care about.

watch.title: What to watch
watch.description: Comma-separated names or * patterns. 'auto' watches every plugin MCP tool (mcp__plugin_*) and every plugin skill. Examples: auto, mcp__my-server__*, mcp__plugin_my-plugin_db__query, skill:my-plugin:*, Bash

open_on_start.title: Open the pane at session start
open_on_start.description: The expanded view. Off means it opens with /tool-lights or the strip's expand button.

show_strip.title: Show the strip above the prompt
show_strip.description: The compact one-line view. Off means only the /tool-lights pane.
